import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long flow, cap;
        Edge(int src, int dst, long flow, long cap) {
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int src_node, dst_node;
        List<Edge> edge_list;
        List<Integer>[] adj;
        int[] level;
        int[] iter;
        int MAX_NODES;

        Dinic(int maxNodes) {
            MAX_NODES = maxNodes;
            edge_list = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new List[MAX_NODES];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; ++i) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            level = new int[MAX_NODES];
            iter = new int[MAX_NODES];
        }

        void reset() {
            edge_list.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; ++i) {
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, long capacity) {
            edge_list.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, capacity));
            edge_list.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            adj[u].add(edge_list.size() - 2);
            adj[v].add(edge_list.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean buildLevels() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[src_node] = 0;
            q.offer(src_node);

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int eid : adj[u]) {
                    Edge e = edge_list.get(eid);
                    if (e.cap > e.flow && level[e.dst] < 0) {
                        level[e.dst] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.dst);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[dst_node] >= 0;
        }

        long pushFlow(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == dst_node || flow == 0) return flow;
            for (; iter[u] < adj[u].size(); ++iter[u]) {
                int eid = adj[u].get(iter[u]);
                Edge e = edge_list.get(eid);
                if (level[e.dst] == level[u] + 1 && e.cap > e.flow) {
                    long pushed = pushFlow(e.dst, Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        edge_list.get(eid ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long compute() {
            long total = 0;
            while (buildLevels()) {
                Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = pushFlow(src_node, Long.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static char[][] map1 = new char[14][14];
    static char[][] map2 = new char[14][14];
    static boolean[][] marked = new boolean[14][14];
    static int[][] timeDist = new int[14][14];
    static int N, T;
    static int[] sinkMap = new int[103];

    static void computeDistances(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 14; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(timeDist[i], 111);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        timeDist[x][y] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{x, y, 0});

        int[] dr = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dc = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int r = cur[0], c = cur[1], d = cur[2];
            if (marked[r][c]) continue;
            marked[r][c] = true;
            timeDist[r][c] = d;

            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + dr[i], nc = c + dc[i];
                if (nr >= 1 && nr <= N && nc >= 1 && nc <= N &&
                    !marked[nr][nc] && map1[nr][nc] != 'Y') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc, d + 1});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int encode(int level, int r, int c) {
        return level * N * N + (r - 1) * N + c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            map1[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            map2[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }

        Dinic solver = new Dinic(7100);
        solver.src_node = 0;
        solver.dst_node = 7098;

        int startR = 0, startC = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (map1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    startR = i;
                    startC = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N * N; ++i) {
            sinkMap[i] = 7097 - (N * N - i);
        }

        computeDistances(startR, startC);

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(map1[i][j])) {
                    solver.connect(solver.src_node, encode(0, i, j), map1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(map2[i][j])) {
                    solver.connect(sinkMap[encode(0, i, j)], solver.dst_node, map2[i][j] - '0');
                }
                solver.connect(encode(0, i, j), sinkMap[encode(0, i, j)], 1000000000L);
            }
        }

        int[] dr = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dc = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        for (int step = 1; step <= T; ++step) {
            for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
                for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) {
                    if (map1[r][c] == 'Y' || map1[r][c] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int nr = r + dr[d], nc = c + dc[d];
                        if (nr >= 1 && nr <= N && nc >= 1 && nc <= N &&
                            map1[nr][nc] != 'Y' && map1[nr][nc] != 'Z' &&
                            timeDist[r][c] >= step && timeDist[nr][nc] >= step) {
                            solver.connect(encode(step - 1, nr, nc), encode(step, r, c), 1000000000L);
                        }
                    }
                    solver.connect(encode(step, r, c), sinkMap[encode(0, r, c)], 1000000000L);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solver.compute());
    }
}
